datasets.name: Chennai Historical Flood Hotspots (demonstration)
datasets.description: Neighbourhoods widely documented as severely flood-affected during the Nov–Dec 2015 Chennai floods. Locations are real; flood depth and event attributes are ILLUSTRATIVE demonstration values, not measured records.
datasets.license: Demonstration data — not for operational use

datasets.name: Chennai Water Bodies (lakes, ponds, reservoirs)
datasets.description: Named water bodies within the Chennai administrative area.

datasets.name: Chennai Flood Hazard Zones (demonstration)
datasets.description: Illustrative hazard polygons over known low-lying basins (Pallikaranai marsh catchment, Adyar/Cooum floodplain). DEMONSTRATION geometry only.
datasets.license: Demonstration data — not for operational use

datasets.name: Chennai Rainfall Observation Sites (demonstration)
datasets.source_org: FloodLens AI (illustrative; station localities after IMD/WRD network)
datasets.description: Observation-point localities approximating the IMD / TN-WRD rain-gauge network around Chennai. DEMONSTRATION values; not measured rainfall.
datasets.license: Demonstration data — not for operational use
